# Statue model attribution

- Title: **Statue**
- Author: **Zman** (`Zman174637` on Sketchfab)
- Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/statue-f88e0c1f469348ff934ec6c8b417f3e0
- License: **CC BY 4.0** — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The original rig, materials, textures, skin, and `Scene` animation are preserved in `statue.glb`. The Unity prefab adds gameplay navigation, perception, collision, gaze behavior, and uniform visual-height normalization without flattening the animated model.
